Company History

Established 1972

Esmaely Lenzohm Electrical Co. W.L.L. — trading as ELECO — was founded in 1972. Over five decades of continuous operation, the company has grown into one of Bahrain's most experienced Grade 'A' electrical contracting firms, serving the Kingdom's largest industrial operators.

ELECO holds Grade 'A' registration with the Ministry of Electricity & Water and employs engineers authorised by the Ministry for High Voltage switching of Private HV Consumers' switch-gears — a qualification held by very few contractors in Bahrain.

In 1994, ELECO expanded with the construction of a purpose-built factory for the repair of static and rotating electrical equipment in the South Alba Industrial Area. This facility — equipped with a 20-ton overhead crane, VPI plant, and in-house machining — remains one of the largest electrical repair workshops in the Kingdom.

Credentials

Memberships & Certifications

Grade 'A' Contractor

Ministry of Electricity & Water, Kingdom of Bahrain

The highest electrical contractor classification issued by Bahrain's Ministry of Electricity & Water. This registration authorises ELECO to carry out the full spectrum of HV and LV electrical works, including switching of Private HV Consumers' switch-gears.

EASA Member

Electrical Apparatus Service Association — USA, European & World Chapter

EASA is the global trade organisation for electromechanical repair companies. Membership requires commitment to quality standards, ethical practices, and ongoing technical training. ELECO holds European and World Chapter membership.

AEMT Member

Association of Electrical and Mechanical Trades — United Kingdom

The AEMT is the recognised professional body for electro-mechanical service companies in the UK and internationally. Membership confirms adherence to quality codes of practice for motor repair, rewinding, and service.

TÜV CERT

DN EN ISO 9001 Quality Management

ISO 9001 certification from TÜV, one of the world's most recognised technical inspection and certification bodies, confirms that ELECO's quality management processes meet international standards for consistent, audited service delivery.
